text: NOTES: (1) In R-1 and R-2 Districts, minor dependent children in the care of a parent or relative shall be excluded in determining the number of unrelated occupants. (2) Properties in the South Hill Overlay District with a zoning designation of R-1 or R-2, see §325-8(E). (3) Properties less than 60,000 SF may only have one primary structure. Properties greater than 60,000 SF may have two primary uses, if approved by ILPC and Planning Board. Properties with at least 90,000 SF can have as many as three primary uses if approved by ILPC and Planning Board. (4) See §325-3 for occupancy restrictions. (5) Restricted to one every 500 feet for new construction, measured from the edge of the property line. (6) For not more than three cars. (7) For not more than six cars per building. (8) Not to remain for over two years.

text: NOTES: (1) See §325-8(D). (2) For the first 1-3 units; +750 sf for each additional unit; +500 sf per room let for profit. (3) See §325-16. (4) CBD-140 has a maximum building height of 12 stories. (5) Each of the CBD sub-districts have a maximum building height that corresponds with its suffix - for example CBD-50 has a maximum building height of 50 feet, CBD-100 has a maximum building height of 100 feet, etc. (6) Minimum building height requirement shall not apply to development, including additions and/or expansions of existing development where the new development or addition or expansion of the existing development does not exceed a footprint of 500 square feet. (7) 75% when adequate off-street parking is available within 500 ft, see §325-20. (8) Except as required for rear yard or side yard, as applicable. (9) But not less than 10 ft.
